with regional_customers as (
  select
    c.c_custkey,
    n.n_name as cust_nation,
    r.r_name as cust_region
  from customer c
  join nation n on n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  join region r on r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  where r.r_name in ('ASIA', 'EUROPE')
),
orders_in_scope as (
  select
    o.o_orderkey,
    o.o_custkey,
    o.o_orderdate
  from orders o
  join regional_customers rc on rc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  where o.o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'
    and o.o_orderdate < date '1996-01-01'
),
supplier_region as (
  select
    s.s_suppkey,
    n.n_name as supp_nation,
    r.r_name as supp_region
  from supplier s
  join nation n on n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  join region r on r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
),
partsupp_stats as (
  select
    ps.ps_partkey,
    sr.supp_region,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by ps.ps_supplycost) as median_supplycost,
    avg(ps.ps_supplycost) as avg_supplycost,
    min(ps.ps_supplycost) as min_supplycost
  from partsupp ps
  join supplier_region sr on sr.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
  group by ps.ps_partkey, sr.supp_region
),
best_suppliers_by_region as (
  select
    ps.ps_partkey,
    sr.supp_region,
    ps.ps_suppkey,
    row_number() over (partition by ps.ps_partkey, sr.supp_region order by ps.ps_supplycost asc, ps.ps_suppkey) as rn
  from partsupp ps
  join supplier_region sr on sr.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
),
revenue_lines as (
  select
    li.l_orderkey,
    li.l_partkey,
    li.l_suppkey,
    li.l_quantity,
    li.l_extendedprice,
    li.l_discount,
    (li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount))::numeric as revenue,
    oi.o_orderdate,
    date_trunc('month', oi.o_orderdate)::date as order_month,
    rc.cust_region,
    sr.supp_region
  from lineitem li
  join orders_in_scope oi on oi.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey
  join regional_customers rc on rc.c_custkey = oi.o_custkey
  join supplier_region sr on sr.s_suppkey = li.l_suppkey
  where rc.cust_region = sr.supp_region
),
rev_enriched as (
  select
    rl.order_month,
    rl.l_partkey,
    rl.l_suppkey,
    rl.revenue,
    rl.l_quantity,
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    rl.supp_region,
    p.p_size,
    psst.median_supplycost,
    psst.avg_supplycost,
    psst.min_supplycost,
    case when bsr.rn = 1 then true else false end as is_lowest_cost_supplier_in_region,
    sum(rl.revenue) over (partition by rl.order_month, p.p_brand, rl.supp_region, rl.l_suppkey) as supplier_brand_month_rev,
    sum(rl.revenue) over (partition by rl.order_month, p.p_brand, rl.supp_region) as total_brand_month_rev
  from revenue_lines rl
  join part p on p.p_partkey = rl.l_partkey
  join partsupp_stats psst on psst.ps_partkey = rl.l_partkey and psst.supp_region = rl.supp_region
  left join best_suppliers_by_region bsr on bsr.ps_partkey = rl.l_partkey and bsr.supp_region = rl.supp_region and bsr.ps_suppkey = rl.l_suppkey
),
monthly_agg as (
  select
    order_month,
    p_brand,
    supp_region,
    sum(revenue) as total_revenue,
    avg(l_quantity) as avg_quantity,
    count(distinct l_suppkey) as supplier_count,
    sum(case when is_lowest_cost_supplier_in_region then revenue else 0 end) as lowest_cost_supplier_revenue,
    avg(case when revenue > 0 then (avg_supplycost / nullif(revenue,0)) end) as avg_cost_to_revenue_ratio,
    max(median_supplycost) as median_supplycost_proxy
  from rev_enriched
  group by order_month, p_brand, supp_region
),
brand_region_analytics as (
  select
    ma.*,
    dense_rank() over (partition by ma.p_brand, ma.order_month order by ma.total_revenue desc) as region_rank_in_brand_month,
    avg(ma.total_revenue) over (partition by ma.p_brand, ma.supp_region order by ma.order_month rows between 2 preceding and current row) as moving_avg_revenue_3m,
    sum(ma.total_revenue) over (partition by ma.p_brand, ma.supp_region order by ma.order_month rows between 2 preceding and current row) as moving_sum_revenue_3m,
    lag(ma.total_revenue, 12) over (partition by ma.p_brand, ma.supp_region order by ma.order_month) as total_revenue_12m_ago,
    (ma.total_revenue - lag(ma.total_revenue, 12) over (partition by ma.p_brand, ma.supp_region order by ma.order_month)) / nullif(lag(ma.total_revenue, 12) over (partition by ma.p_brand, ma.supp_region order by ma.order_month), 0) as yoy_growth_ratio,
    (ma.lowest_cost_supplier_revenue / nullif(ma.total_revenue, 0)) as share_lowest_cost_revenue
  from monthly_agg ma
)
select
  order_month,
  p_brand,
  supp_region,
  total_revenue,
  avg_quantity,
  supplier_count,
  region_rank_in_brand_month,
  moving_avg_revenue_3m,
  moving_sum_revenue_3m,
  total_revenue_12m_ago,
  yoy_growth_ratio,
  share_lowest_cost_revenue,
  median_supplycost_proxy
from brand_region_analytics
where region_rank_in_brand_month <= 3
  and share_lowest_cost_revenue > 0.4
order by p_brand, order_month, supp_region;

SELECT
  p.p_brand,
  sr.r_name AS supplier_region,
  date_part('year', o.o_orderdate) AS order_year,
  SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue,
  AVG(li.l_tax) AS avg_tax,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customer AS c
  ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation AS cn
  ON c.c_nationkey = cn.n_nationkey
JOIN region AS cr
  ON cn.n_regionkey = cr.r_regionkey
JOIN lineitem AS li
  ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier AS s
  ON li.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation AS sn
  ON s.s_nationkey = sn.n_nationkey
JOIN region AS sr
  ON sn.n_regionkey = sr.r_regionkey
JOIN part AS p
  ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE
  cr.r_name = 'ASIA'
  AND sr.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
  AND p.p_type LIKE '%ECONOMY%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM partsupp AS ps
    WHERE ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
      AND ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
      AND ps.ps_supplycost < (
        SELECT AVG(ps2.ps_supplycost)
        FROM partsupp AS ps2
        WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
      )
  )
GROUP BY
  p.p_brand,
  sr.r_name,
  date_part('year', o.o_orderdate)
HAVING
  SUM(li.l_quantity) > 100;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    rs.r_name AS region_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)::int AS order_year,
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    l.l_orderkey,
    l.l_partkey,
    l.l_suppkey,
    (l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount))::numeric AS revenue,
    (ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity)::numeric AS cost,
    GREATEST((l.l_receiptdate - l.l_commitdate), 0) AS delay_days,
    (l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate) AS is_late
  FROM lineitem l
  JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
  JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN nation ns ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  JOIN nation nc ON nc.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  JOIN region rs ON rs.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey
  JOIN region rc ON rc.r_regionkey = nc.n_regionkey
  WHERE rc.r_name = rs.r_name
    AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01'
    AND p.p_type ILIKE '%STEEL%'
),
supplier_year_agg AS (
  SELECT
    region_name,
    order_year,
    s_suppkey,
    MAX(s_name) AS s_name,
    SUM(revenue) AS supplier_revenue,
    SUM(revenue - cost) AS supplier_margin,
    AVG(revenue - cost) AS avg_line_margin,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late) AS late_cnt,
    COUNT(*) AS line_cnt,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS late_rate
  FROM base
  GROUP BY region_name, order_year, s_suppkey
),
region_year_stats AS (
  SELECT
    region_name,
    order_year,
    SUM(revenue) AS region_year_revenue,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS region_late_rate,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NULLIF(delay_days, 0)) AS median_delay_days
  FROM base
  GROUP BY region_name, order_year
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    sya.region_name,
    sya.order_year,
    sya.s_suppkey,
    sya.s_name,
    sya.supplier_revenue,
    sya.supplier_margin,
    sya.avg_line_margin,
    sya.late_rate,
    rys.region_year_revenue,
    rys.region_late_rate,
    rys.median_delay_days,
    (sya.supplier_revenue / NULLIF(rys.region_year_revenue, 0)) AS revenue_share,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sya.region_name, sya.order_year ORDER BY sya.supplier_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sya.region_name, sya.order_year ORDER BY sya.supplier_margin DESC) AS margin_rank,
    AVG(sya.supplier_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY sya.region_name, sya.order_year) AS region_avg_margin,
    STDDEV_SAMP(sya.supplier_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY sya.region_name, sya.order_year) AS region_std_margin,
    (sya.supplier_margin - AVG(sya.supplier_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY sya.region_name, sya.order_year))
      / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(sya.supplier_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY sya.region_name, sya.order_year), 0) AS margin_z,
    AVG(sya.supplier_margin) OVER (
      PARTITION BY sya.region_name, sya.s_suppkey
      ORDER BY sya.order_year
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_3yr_margin_avg
  FROM supplier_year_agg sya
  JOIN region_year_stats rys
    ON rys.region_name = sya.region_name
   AND rys.order_year = sya.order_year
)
SELECT
  region_name,
  order_year,
  s_suppkey,
  s_name,
  supplier_revenue,
  supplier_margin,
  revenue_share,
  rev_rank,
  margin_rank,
  margin_z,
  rolling_3yr_margin_avg,
  late_rate,
  region_late_rate,
  median_delay_days
FROM ranked
WHERE rev_rank <= 3
   OR (margin_z >= 1 AND revenue_share >= 0.15)
ORDER BY region_name, order_year, rev_rank, s_suppkey;

WITH orders_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        o.o_orderkey,
        o.o_custkey,
        o.o_orderdate
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
),
li_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        l.l_orderkey,
        l.l_partkey,
        l.l_suppkey,
        l.l_quantity,
        l.l_extendedprice,
        l.l_discount,
        l.l_tax,
        o.o_orderdate,
        p.p_brand,
        p.p_mfgr,
        p.p_type,
        p.p_size,
        ps.ps_supplycost,
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        sr.r_name AS supp_region,
        cr.r_name AS cust_region,
        o.o_custkey
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders_filtered o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
    JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
                   AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    JOIN nation sn ON sn.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    JOIN region sr ON sr.r_regionkey = sn.n_regionkey
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN nation cn ON cn.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    JOIN region cr ON cr.r_regionkey = cn.n_regionkey
    WHERE sr.r_name <> cr.r_name
),
supplier_perf AS (
    SELECT
        supp_region,
        p_brand,
        s_suppkey,
        s_name,
        SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue,
        SUM(l_quantity * ps_supplycost) AS cost,
        SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) - SUM(l_quantity * ps_supplycost) AS profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT l_orderkey) AS order_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o_custkey) AS cust_cnt,
        AVG(l_discount) AS avg_discount
    FROM li_enriched
    GROUP BY supp_region, p_brand, s_suppkey, s_name
),
brand_stats AS (
    SELECT
        supp_region,
        p_brand,
        AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue,
        percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revenue) AS median_revenue
    FROM supplier_perf
    GROUP BY supp_region, p_brand
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        sp.*,
        SUM(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY supp_region, p_brand) AS total_profit_rb,
        100.0 * profit / NULLIF(SUM(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY supp_region, p_brand), 0) AS profit_share_pct,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY supp_region, p_brand ORDER BY profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY supp_region ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS region_revenue_rank
    FROM supplier_perf sp
)
SELECT
    r.supp_region,
    r.p_brand,
    r.s_suppkey,
    r.s_name,
    r.revenue,
    r.cost,
    r.profit,
    r.order_cnt,
    r.cust_cnt,
    r.avg_discount,
    r.total_profit_rb,
    r.profit_share_pct,
    r.profit_rank,
    r.region_revenue_rank,
    bs.avg_revenue,
    bs.median_revenue
FROM ranked r
JOIN brand_stats bs
  ON bs.supp_region = r.supp_region
 AND bs.p_brand = r.p_brand
WHERE r.revenue > bs.avg_revenue
  AND r.profit_rank <= 3;

WITH base_lines AS (
    SELECT
        cr.r_name AS cust_region,
        sr.r_name AS supp_region,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)::int AS order_year,
        p.p_brand AS brand,
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        ps.ps_supplycost,
        l.l_quantity::numeric AS qty,
        (l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount))::numeric AS net_revenue
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN nation cn ON cn.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    JOIN region cr ON cr.r_regionkey = cn.n_regionkey
    JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
    JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    JOIN nation sn ON sn.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    JOIN region sr ON sr.r_regionkey = sn.n_regionkey
    JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND l.l_returnflag <> 'R'
),
brand_region_year_rev AS (
    SELECT
        cust_region,
        order_year,
        brand,
        SUM(net_revenue)::numeric AS brand_rev
    FROM base_lines
    GROUP BY cust_region, order_year, brand
),
region_year_totals AS (
    SELECT
        cust_region,
        order_year,
        SUM(brand_rev)::numeric AS region_year_rev
    FROM brand_region_year_rev
    GROUP BY cust_region, order_year
),
brand_share AS (
    SELECT
        b.cust_region,
        b.order_year,
        b.brand,
        b.brand_rev,
        (b.brand_rev / NULLIF(t.region_year_rev, 0))::numeric AS brand_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.cust_region, b.order_year ORDER BY b.brand_rev DESC) AS brand_rank
    FROM brand_region_year_rev b
    JOIN region_year_totals t USING (cust_region, order_year)
),
median_share AS (
    SELECT
        cust_region,
        order_year,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY brand_share) AS median_share
    FROM brand_share
    GROUP BY cust_region, order_year
),
filtered_brands AS (
    SELECT
        s.cust_region,
        s.order_year,
        s.brand,
        s.brand_rev,
        s.brand_share,
        s.brand_rank
    FROM brand_share s
    JOIN median_share m USING (cust_region, order_year)
    WHERE s.brand_share >= m.median_share
),
supplier_contrib AS (
    SELECT
        bl.cust_region,
        bl.order_year,
        bl.brand,
        bl.s_suppkey,
        bl.s_name,
        MIN(bl.supp_region) AS supp_region,
        SUM(bl.net_revenue)::numeric AS supplier_rev,
        SUM(bl.qty * bl.ps_supplycost)::numeric AS cost_weighted_sum,
        SUM(bl.qty)::numeric AS qty_sum
    FROM base_lines bl
    JOIN filtered_brands fb
      ON fb.cust_region = bl.cust_region
     AND fb.order_year = bl.order_year
     AND fb.brand = bl.brand
    GROUP BY bl.cust_region, bl.order_year, bl.brand, bl.s_suppkey, bl.s_name
),
brand_region_cost AS (
    SELECT
        bl.cust_region,
        bl.order_year,
        bl.brand,
        (SUM(bl.qty * bl.ps_supplycost)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(bl.qty)::numeric, 0)) AS brand_weighted_avg_cost
    FROM base_lines bl
    JOIN filtered_brands fb
      ON fb.cust_region = bl.cust_region
     AND fb.order_year = bl.order_year
     AND fb.brand = bl.brand
    GROUP BY bl.cust_region, bl.order_year, bl.brand
),
supplier_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        sc.cust_region,
        sc.order_year,
        sc.brand,
        sc.s_suppkey,
        sc.s_name,
        sc.supp_region,
        sc.supplier_rev,
        (sc.cost_weighted_sum / NULLIF(sc.qty_sum, 0))::numeric AS avg_supply_cost,
        (sc.supplier_rev / NULLIF(fb.brand_rev, 0))::numeric AS supplier_brand_share,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sc.cust_region, sc.order_year, sc.brand
            ORDER BY sc.supplier_rev DESC
        ) AS supplier_rank,
        (SUM(sc.supplier_rev) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sc.cust_region, sc.order_year, sc.brand
            ORDER BY sc.supplier_rev DESC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) / NULLIF(fb.brand_rev, 0))::numeric AS cumulative_share,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sc.cust_region, sc.order_year, sc.brand
            ORDER BY sc.supplier_rev
        ) AS supplier_percent_rank,
        MIN(sc.order_year) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sc.cust_region, sc.brand, sc.s_suppkey
        ) AS first_year_in_region_brand
    FROM supplier_contrib sc
    JOIN filtered_brands fb
      ON fb.cust_region = sc.cust_region
     AND fb.order_year = sc.order_year
     AND fb.brand = sc.brand
)
SELECT
    sr.cust_region,
    sr.order_year,
    sr.brand,
    sr.supplier_rank,
    sr.s_name AS supplier_name,
    sr.supp_region,
    sr.supplier_rev,
    sr.supplier_brand_share,
    sr.cumulative_share,
    sr.supplier_percent_rank,
    sr.avg_supply_cost,
    (sr.avg_supply_cost - brc.brand_weighted_avg_cost) AS avg_cost_deviation,
    sr.first_year_in_region_brand
FROM supplier_ranked sr
JOIN brand_region_cost brc
  ON brc.cust_region = sr.cust_region
 AND brc.order_year = sr.order_year
 AND brc.brand = sr.brand
WHERE sr.cumulative_share <= 0.8
ORDER BY
    sr.cust_region,
    sr.order_year,
    sr.brand,
    sr.supplier_rank,
    sr.s_name;

WITH df_li AS (
  SELECT
    l.l_orderkey,
    l.l_partkey,
    l.l_suppkey,
    l.l_quantity,
    l.l_extendedprice,
    l.l_discount,
    l.l_tax,
    l.l_shipdate,
    l.l_receiptdate,
    o.o_custkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    (l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue,
    (l.l_receiptdate - l.l_shipdate) AS days_in_transit
  FROM lineitem l
  JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31'
),
sr AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_nationkey,
    n.n_name AS s_nation,
    r.r_name AS s_region
  FROM supplier s
  JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
),
cr AS (
  SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    c.c_nationkey,
    n.n_name AS c_nation,
    r.r_name AS c_region
  FROM customer c
  JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
),
li_full AS (
  SELECT
    df.o_orderdate,
    df.l_orderkey,
    df.l_partkey,
    df.l_suppkey,
    df.l_quantity,
    df.l_extendedprice,
    df.l_discount,
    df.l_tax,
    df.net_revenue,
    df.days_in_transit,
    cr.c_region AS customer_region,
    cr.c_custkey,
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type
  FROM df_li df
  JOIN cr ON cr.c_custkey = df.o_custkey
  JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = df.l_partkey
),
min_cost AS (
  SELECT
    ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp
  GROUP BY ps_partkey
),
cost_ok AS (
  SELECT
    ps.ps_suppkey,
    ps.ps_partkey
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN min_cost mc ON mc.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
  WHERE ps.ps_supplycost <= mc.min_cost * 1.10
),
cost_ok_brand AS (
  SELECT
    co.ps_suppkey AS s_suppkey,
    p.p_brand
  FROM cost_ok co
  JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = co.ps_partkey
  GROUP BY co.ps_suppkey, p.p_brand
),
supplier_brand_region AS (
  SELECT
    lf.customer_region AS region,
    lf.p_brand AS brand,
    lf.l_suppkey AS suppkey,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lf.l_orderkey) AS order_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lf.c_custkey) AS customer_cnt,
    SUM(lf.l_quantity) AS total_qty,
    SUM(lf.net_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(lf.l_discount) AS avg_discount,
    AVG(lf.days_in_transit) AS avg_days_in_transit
  FROM li_full lf
  GROUP BY lf.customer_region, lf.p_brand, lf.l_suppkey
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    sbr.*,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region, brand ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank,
    SUM(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region, brand) AS brand_region_revenue,
    total_revenue / NULLIF(SUM(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region, brand), 0) AS revenue_share,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS percentile_in_region
  FROM supplier_brand_region sbr
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    lf.customer_region AS region,
    lf.p_brand AS brand,
    lf.l_suppkey AS suppkey,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', lf.o_orderdate)::date AS month,
    SUM(lf.net_revenue) AS month_revenue
  FROM li_full lf
  GROUP BY lf.customer_region, lf.p_brand, lf.l_suppkey, DATE_TRUNC('month', lf.o_orderdate)
),
monthly_ma AS (
  SELECT
    m.region,
    m.brand,
    m.suppkey,
    m.month,
    m.month_revenue,
    AVG(m.month_revenue) OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.region, m.brand, m.suppkey
      ORDER BY m.month
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rev_ma_3m
  FROM monthly m
),
latest_ma AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, brand, suppkey)
    region,
    brand,
    suppkey,
    rev_ma_3m AS latest_rev_ma_3m
  FROM monthly_ma
  ORDER BY region, brand, suppkey, month DESC
),
final_candidates AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN cost_ok_brand cob
    ON cob.s_suppkey = r.suppkey
   AND cob.p_brand = r.brand
  WHERE r.rev_rank <= 3
)
SELECT
  fc.region,
  fc.brand,
  fc.suppkey,
  s.s_name AS supplier_name,
  s.s_region AS supplier_region,
  fc.rev_rank,
  fc.order_cnt,
  fc.customer_cnt,
  fc.total_qty,
  fc.total_revenue,
  fc.avg_discount,
  fc.avg_days_in_transit,
  fc.revenue_share,
  fc.percentile_in_region,
  lma.latest_rev_ma_3m,
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost)
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN part p2 ON p2.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = fc.suppkey
      AND p2.p_brand = fc.brand
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM cost_ok co
        WHERE co.ps_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
          AND co.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey

  ) AS ok_inventory_cost,
  (
    SELECT
      percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost)

    JOIN part p2 ON p2.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey

 AND lma.brand = fc.brand

ORDER BY fc.region, fc.brand, fc.rev_rank, fc.suppkey;

SELECT
  rs.r_name AS supplier_region,

  p.p_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_cnt,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue,

FROM orders AS o

SELECT
  s.s_name AS supplier_name,

JOIN orders AS o

JOIN nation AS nc

JOIN region AS r

JOIN supplier AS s
  ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation AS ns
  ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN partsupp AS ps
  ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
 AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN part AS p
  ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
WHERE

  AND ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey

  AND o.o_totalprice > (
    SELECT AVG(o2.o_totalprice)
    FROM orders AS o2
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o2.o_orderdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
  )
GROUP BY
  s.s_name,
  ns.n_name,
  r.r_name
HAVING
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > (
    SELECT AVG(rev)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        SUM(l2.l_extendedprice * (1 - l2.l_discount)) AS rev
      FROM lineitem AS l2
      JOIN orders AS o2
        ON o2.o_orderkey = l2.l_orderkey
      JOIN customer AS c2
        ON c2.c_custkey = o2.o_custkey
      JOIN nation AS nc2
        ON nc2.n_nationkey = c2.c_nationkey
      JOIN region AS r2
        ON r2.r_regionkey = nc2.n_regionkey
      WHERE
        r2.r_name = 'ASIA'
        AND o2.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
        AND o2.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
      GROUP BY l2.l_suppkey
    ) AS t
  )
  AND AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) > (
    SELECT AVG(psx.ps_supplycost)

SELECT
  rs.r_name AS supplier_region,

  COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count,

FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey

JOIN region rc ON rc.r_regionkey = nc.n_regionkey
JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation ns ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN region rs ON rs.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey

WHERE
  o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'

  AND rc.r_name <> rs.r_name
GROUP BY

HAVING

    SELECT AVG(ps2.ps_supplycost)

    JOIN supplier s2 ON s2.s_suppkey = ps2.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey
    JOIN region r2 ON r2.r_regionkey = n2.n_regionkey

SELECT
  r.r_name AS region,
  p.p_brand AS brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count,
  SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) * (1 + l.l_tax)) AS revenue_with_tax,
  SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS supply_cost,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) - SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS profit
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation n_s ON n_s.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n_s.n_regionkey
JOIN nation n_c ON n_c.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE
  o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
  AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('BUILDING', 'AUTOMOBILE')

  AND l.l_shipdate >= o.o_orderdate
  AND n_c.n_name <> n_s.n_name
GROUP BY r.r_name, p.p_brand
HAVING
  COUNT(*) > 5
  AND SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > (
    SELECT AVG(sub_rev) FROM (
      SELECT SUM(l2.l_extendedprice * (1 - l2.l_discount)) AS sub_rev
      FROM lineitem l2
      JOIN orders o2 ON o2.o_orderkey = l2.l_orderkey
      JOIN part p2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.l_partkey
      JOIN supplier s2 ON s2.s_suppkey = l2.l_suppkey
      JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey
      JOIN region r2 ON r2.r_regionkey = n2.n_regionkey
      WHERE p2.p_brand = p.p_brand
        AND o2.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
        AND o2.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
      GROUP BY r2.r_name
    ) brand_region_rev

WITH part_filter AS (
    SELECT p1.p_partkey
    FROM part p1
    WHERE p1.p_retailprice > (
        SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice)
        FROM part p2
        WHERE p2.p_brand = p1.p_brand
    )
      AND p1.p_type NOT LIKE 'PROMO%'
),
customer_filter AS (
    SELECT c.c_custkey, r.r_regionkey
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE c.c_acctbal > (
        SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal)
        FROM customer c2
        JOIN nation n2 ON c2.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
        WHERE n2.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    )
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        rc.r_name AS region_name,
        rc.r_regionkey AS region_key,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)::int AS order_year,
        p.p_brand AS brand,
        c.c_custkey,
        s.s_suppkey,
        l.l_quantity,
        l.l_discount,
        l.l_extendedprice,
        ps.ps_supplycost,
        (l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount))::numeric AS revenue,
        ((l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) - (ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity))::numeric AS margin,
        CASE WHEN l.l_commitdate <= l.l_receiptdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_time
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation nc ON c.c_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey
    JOIN region rc ON nc.n_regionkey = rc.r_regionkey
    JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey
    JOIN region rs ON ns.n_regionkey = rs.r_regionkey
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    JOIN part_filter pf ON pf.p_partkey = p.p_partkey
    JOIN customer_filter cf ON cf.c_custkey = c.c_custkey AND cf.r_regionkey = rc.r_regionkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND rc.r_regionkey = rs.r_regionkey
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        region_name,
        order_year,
        brand,
        SUM(revenue) AS revenue_sum,
        SUM(margin) AS margin_sum,
        AVG(l_discount) AS avg_discount,
        AVG(on_time)::numeric AS on_time_ratio,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c_custkey) AS customer_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
    FROM base
    GROUP BY region_name, order_year, brand
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c_custkey) >= 5
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name, order_year ORDER BY revenue_sum DESC) AS revenue_rank,
        SUM(revenue_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name, order_year) AS total_revenue_year,
        SUM(revenue_sum) OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_name, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue_sum DESC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_revenue,
        AVG(margin_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name, order_year) AS avg_margin_year,
        STDDEV_SAMP(margin_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name, order_year) AS std_margin_year
    FROM agg a
)
SELECT
    region_name,
    order_year,
    brand,
    revenue_sum,
    margin_sum,
    avg_discount,
    on_time_ratio,
    customer_cnt,
    supplier_cnt,
    revenue_rank,
    (100.0 * revenue_sum / NULLIF(total_revenue_year, 0))::numeric(12,4) AS revenue_share_pct,
    (running_revenue / NULLIF(total_revenue_year, 0))::numeric(12,4) AS cumulative_share,
    CASE
        WHEN std_margin_year IS NULL OR std_margin_year = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (margin_sum - avg_margin_year) / std_margin_year
    END AS margin_zscore
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY region_name, order_year, revenue_rank, brand;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.r_name AS customer_region,
    date_trunc('month', l.l_shipdate)::date AS month,
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    l.l_orderkey,
    l.l_quantity,
    l.l_extendedprice,
    l.l_discount,
    l.l_tax,
    l.l_commitdate,
    l.l_receiptdate,
    ps.ps_supplycost
  FROM lineitem l
  JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN nation cn ON cn.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = cn.n_regionkey
  JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
),
supplier_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    customer_region,
    month,
    s_suppkey,
    s_name,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l_orderkey) AS order_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate > l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax))::numeric AS revenue,
    SUM(l_quantity * ps_supplycost)::numeric AS cost,
    (SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) - SUM(l_quantity * ps_supplycost))::numeric AS margin
  FROM base
  GROUP BY customer_region, month, s_suppkey, s_name
),
supplier_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    sm.*,
    (late_count::numeric / NULLIF(line_count,0)) AS late_ratio,
    SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month) AS region_month_revenue,
    revenue / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month),0) AS revenue_share_in_region_month,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month ORDER BY margin DESC) AS rank_by_margin,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month ORDER BY margin) AS margin_percent_rank,
    AVG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month) AS avg_region_month_margin,
    STDDEV_SAMP(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month) AS std_region_month_margin,
    CASE
      WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (margin - AVG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month))
           / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month),0)
    END AS margin_zscore,
    LAG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, s_suppkey ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_margin,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, s_suppkey ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LAG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, s_suppkey ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (margin - LAG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, s_suppkey ORDER BY month))
           / NULLIF(LAG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, s_suppkey ORDER BY month),0)
    END AS mom_margin_pct_change,
    AVG(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, s_suppkey ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3m_avg_margin,
    AVG(late_count::numeric / NULLIF(line_count,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month) AS avg_late_ratio_region_month
  FROM supplier_monthly sm
),
region_avg_acctbal AS (
  SELECT
    r.r_name AS region,
    AVG(s.s_acctbal)::numeric AS avg_region_acctbal
  FROM supplier s
  JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  GROUP BY r.r_name
),
eligible_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    sm.customer_region,
    sm.month,
    sm.s_suppkey,
    sm.s_name,
    sm.line_count,
    sm.order_count,
    sm.late_count,
    sm.revenue,
    sm.cost,
    sm.margin,
    sm.late_ratio,
    sm.region_month_revenue,
    sm.revenue_share_in_region_month,
    sm.rank_by_margin,
    sm.margin_percent_rank,
    sm.avg_region_month_margin,
    sm.std_region_month_margin,
    sm.margin_zscore,
    sm.prev_month_margin,
    sm.mom_margin_pct_change,
    sm.rolling_3m_avg_margin,
    sm.avg_late_ratio_region_month
  FROM supplier_metrics sm
  JOIN region_avg_acctbal ra ON ra.region = sm.customer_region
  JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = sm.s_suppkey
  WHERE s.s_acctbal > ra.avg_region_acctbal
    AND sm.order_count >= 5
    AND sm.late_ratio <= sm.avg_late_ratio_region_month
),
top_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    SUM(margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_region, month ORDER BY rank_by_margin ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_margin_by_rank
  FROM eligible_suppliers e
  WHERE e.rank_by_margin <= 3
)
SELECT
  customer_region AS region,
  month,
  s_suppkey AS supplier_key,
  s_name AS supplier_name,
  order_count,
  line_count,
  revenue,
  cost,
  margin,
  revenue_share_in_region_month,
  rank_by_margin,
  margin_percent_rank,
  margin_zscore,
  prev_month_margin,
  mom_margin_pct_change,
  rolling_3m_avg_margin,
  cumulative_margin_by_rank
FROM top_ranked
ORDER BY region, month, rank_by_margin, supplier_key;

with
filtered_li as (
  select
    l.l_orderkey,
    l.l_partkey,
    l.l_suppkey,
    l.l_linenumber,
    l.l_quantity,
    l.l_extendedprice,
    l.l_discount,
    l.l_tax,
    l.l_shipdate,
    l.l_commitdate,
    l.l_receiptdate,
    l.l_returnflag,
    l.l_linestatus,
    l.l_shipinstruct,
    l.l_shipmode,
    l.l_comment,
    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_orderpriority,
    o.o_orderstatus,
    c.c_custkey,
    cn.n_name as cust_nation,
    cr.r_name as cust_region
  from lineitem l
  join orders o on o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  join customer c on c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  join nation cn on cn.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  join region cr on cr.r_regionkey = cn.n_regionkey
  where l.l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
),
brand_revenue as (
  select
    p.p_brand,
    sum((fl.l_extendedprice * (1 - fl.l_discount))::numeric) as revenue
  from filtered_li fl
  join part p on p.p_partkey = fl.l_partkey
  group by p.p_brand
),
top_brands as (
  select p_brand
  from (
    select
      p_brand,
      revenue,
      dense_rank() over (order by revenue desc) as rnk
    from brand_revenue
  ) t
  where rnk <= 5
),
supplier_enriched_li as (
  select
    fl.*,
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    sn.n_name as supp_nation,
    sr.r_name as supp_region
  from filtered_li fl
  join part p on p.p_partkey = fl.l_partkey
  join supplier s on s.s_suppkey = fl.l_suppkey
  join nation sn on sn.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  join region sr on sr.r_regionkey = sn.n_regionkey
  where p.p_brand in (select p_brand from top_brands)
    and sr.r_name = fl.cust_region
),
supplier_year_agg as (
  select
    sel.s_suppkey,
    sel.s_name,
    sel.supp_nation,
    sel.supp_region,
    extract(year from sel.l_shipdate)::int as ship_year,
    sum((sel.l_extendedprice * (1 - sel.l_discount))::numeric) as revenue,
    sum(((sel.l_extendedprice * (1 - sel.l_discount))::numeric) - ((ps.ps_supplycost * sel.l_quantity)::numeric)) as margin,
    sum(sel.l_quantity)::numeric as total_qty,
    count(*)::bigint as line_count
  from supplier_enriched_li sel
  join partsupp ps on ps.ps_partkey = sel.l_partkey and ps.ps_suppkey = sel.s_suppkey
  group by sel.s_suppkey, sel.s_name, sel.supp_nation, sel.supp_region, ship_year
),
supplier_year_stats as (
  select
    sya.*,
    sum(sya.revenue) over (partition by sya.supp_region, sya.ship_year) as region_year_revenue,
    dense_rank() over (partition by sya.supp_nation, sya.ship_year order by sya.margin desc, sya.revenue desc, sya.s_suppkey) as nation_rank,
    lag(sya.margin) over (partition by sya.s_suppkey order by sya.ship_year) as prev_year_margin
  from supplier_year_agg sya
),
supplier_year_stats2 as (
  select
    sys.*,
    case
      when sys.prev_year_margin is null or sys.prev_year_margin = 0 then null
      else (sys.margin - sys.prev_year_margin) / sys.prev_year_margin
    end as yoy_margin_growth,
    case
      when sys.region_year_revenue = 0 then null
      else sys.revenue / sys.region_year_revenue
    end as region_share
  from supplier_year_stats sys
),
supplier_period_avg as (
  select
    sel.s_suppkey,
    sel.supp_nation,
    avg(sel.l_quantity)::numeric as supplier_period_avg_qty
  from supplier_enriched_li sel
  group by sel.s_suppkey, sel.supp_nation
),
supplier_period_avg_with_nation as (
  select
    spa.*,
    avg(spa.supplier_period_avg_qty) over (partition by spa.supp_nation) as nation_period_avg_qty
  from supplier_period_avg spa
)
select
  sys2.supp_region as region_name,
  sys2.supp_nation as nation_name,
  sys2.s_name as supplier_name,
  sys2.ship_year,
  sys2.revenue,
  sys2.margin,
  sys2.yoy_margin_growth,
  sys2.nation_rank,
  sys2.region_share,
  spaw.supplier_period_avg_qty,
  spaw.nation_period_avg_qty
from supplier_year_stats2 sys2
join supplier_period_avg_with_nation spaw on spaw.s_suppkey = sys2.s_suppkey
where spaw.supplier_period_avg_qty > spaw.nation_period_avg_qty
order by sys2.supp_region, sys2.ship_year, sys2.nation_rank, sys2.s_name;
empty_results:
SELECT
  r.r_name AS region,
  n.n_name AS customer_nation,
  p.p_brand AS brand,
  s.s_name AS supplier_name,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
  SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
  AND ps.ps_supplycost < (
    SELECT AVG(ps2.ps_supplycost)
    FROM partsupp ps2
    JOIN supplier s2 ON ps2.ps_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation sn2 ON s2.s_nationkey = sn2.n_nationkey
    WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
      AND sn2.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  )
GROUP BY
  r.r_name,
  n.n_name,
  p.p_brand,
  s.s_name
HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 1000
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC,
  p.p_brand,
  s.s_name;
